prompt.zh-TW: 河岸麵包坊用現金 {{money:e1.amount}} 付了這個月把麵包送到各家咖啡店的包裝運送費。這筆支出之後，下面四個數字各會怎麼變？
prompt.en: Riverside Bakery pays {{money:e1.amount}} in cash for this month’s packing and delivery of bread to cafés. After this payment, how does each of the four figures below change?

explanation.zh-TW: 包裝運送費是銷管費用，所以銷管費用小計增加 {{money:e1.amount}}，營業利益減少同樣的金額；營業毛利不受影響，因為它只看收入減營業成本。現金當然也減少了 {{money:e1.amount}}。
explanation.en: Packing and delivery is a distribution cost, so the subtotal rises by {{money:e1.amount}} and operating profit falls by the same amount. Gross profit is untouched, because it only looks at revenue less cost of sales. Cash, of course, also falls by {{money:e1.amount}}.
